sources.title: GitHub - uniquehere00/gpt2-instruction-finetuned: Instruction fine ...
sources.snippet: Fine-tuning a 355M parameter GPT-2 transformer on an Alpaca-style instruction dataset. The GPT-2 architecture is implemented from scratch in PyTorch with pretrained OpenAI weights loaded manually from TensorFlow checkpoints. Training was conducted on Kaggle T4 GPU, completing 2 epochs in under 4 minutes with consistent loss reduction across both training and validation sets.
